acquisition method: Mass spectrometry analysis was performed in a data-dependent mode with Full-MS with a resolution of 120,000 at m/z = 200
collision energy: HCD-MS/MS (resolution of 15,000) of the most intense ions in 3 s was used to fragment multiply charged ions within a 1.4 Da isolation window at a normalized collision energy of 32%.
enrichment method: we identified the protein substrates of TMTC1 using a glycoproteomic approach... performing the ConA pull-down assay with control or TMTC1 knockdown cells.
fragmentation method: LC-MS/MS analysis with HCD and/or EThcD fragmentation was conducted on an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid quadrupole-ion trap-Orbitrap mass spectrometer
instrument: Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid quadrupole-ion trap-Orbitrap mass spectrometer
LC-MS/MS analysis with HCD and/or EThcD fragmentation was conducted on an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid quadrupole-ion trap-Orbitrap mass spectrometer
labeling: The results uncovered 17 proteins in the secretory pathway with decreased ConA binding (>2-fold change) in TMTC1 knockdown cells
